statement: A detector that recognizes only one narrow spelling of a capability treats every other common form as absent, which specifically defeats the remediation loop: a user fixes the exact thing a finding names, in its ordinary public-documentation form, reruns, and the finding does not move. Three instances in one signal: an exact-quote-bounded route regex missed Kubernetes-style suffixes (/healthz) and any mount prefix or suffix; a vendor-name allowlist missed common logging libraries (pino/winston/bunyan) and the request-correlation idiom, despite already matching an unrelated term by accidental substring; a filename-only check for one framework's convention (error-boundary/error.tsx) never read content, so it missed another framework's content-defined idiom (Express's four-argument error middleware) wherever it lived. Each fix needed a before/after guard proving the signal moves plus a negative guard proving no over-match, both shown failing pre-fix.
